meta.title: Daftr | Simple inventory management for small businesses
meta.description: Daftr replaces paper ledgers and spreadsheets with a simple, affordable inventory app for coffee shops, mini markets and snack shops.

hero.subtitle: Daftr gives coffee shops, mini markets and snack shops a simple, affordable way to track inventory. No complex software, no expensive licences, no training required.

trust.title: Built for the businesses that keep neighbourhoods running

features.title: Everything a small business needs. Nothing it doesn't.
features.description: Four focused tools that replace the notebook behind the counter, designed to be understood in minutes.

items.title: A private account for your business
items.description: Sign up in a minute and get a secure workspace. Only you and the people you invite can see your stock.

items.title: Import from paper or Excel
items.description: Bring your existing inventory over from a paper ledger or an Excel sheet, without starting from scratch.

items.title: Manage every product
items.description: Add, edit, delete and search products in seconds, from a phone at the counter or an older computer in the back office.

items.title: A dashboard that makes sense
items.description: See stock value, low-stock items and top products at a glance, so you always know what to reorder.

howItWorks.title: From notebook to dashboard in three steps.
howItWorks.description: No consultants and no installation. Daftr runs in your browser.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Sign up with your email and name your business. It takes less than a minute.

steps.title: Bring your inventory
steps.description: Upload your Excel sheet or type in products from your ledger. We guide you through it.

steps.title: Track and grow
steps.description: Update stock as you sell and use your dashboard to make better buying decisions.

pricing.title: Simple pricing for small budgets.
pricing.description: Start free and upgrade only when your business needs more. No setup fees and no long contracts.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: For a single shop moving off paper.

plans.name: Business
plans.description: For growing shops that need the full picture.

plans.name: Plus
plans.description: For owners with more than one location.

about.title: Made for the shop on the corner.
paragraphs: Many small businesses still track their stock in a notebook or a spreadsheet. Enterprise software exists, but it is too expensive and too complicated for a coffee shop or a mini market.
We built Daftr to close that gap: the benefits of digital inventory management, without the cost, the setup or the learning curve.

values.title: Easy to use
values.description: If you can use a phone, you can use Daftr.

values.title: Affordable
values.description: Priced for small shops, not large companies.

values.title: Mobile friendly
values.description: Check stock from the counter or on the go.

values.title: Lightweight
values.description: Fast on older computers and slow connections.

contact.title: Questions? We're here to help.
contact.description: Not sure if Daftr fits your business, or need help moving your inventory over? Send us a message and a real person will reply.
